auto_zoom.title: Auto Zoom
auto_zoom.description: If true, crop the output to the smallest rectangle the subject stays inside for the whole video.

preserve_audio.title: Preserve Audio
preserve_audio.description: If true, audio will be preserved in the output video.

video_url.title: Video Url
video_url.description: Input video to remove background from.

background_color.title: Background Color
background_color.description: Background color. Options: Transparent, Black, White, Gray, Red, Green, Blue, Yellow, Cyan, Magenta, Orange.

output_container_and_codec.title: Output Container And Codec
output_container_and_codec.description: Output container and codec. Options: mp4_h265, mp4_h264, webm_vp9, mov_h265, mov_proresks, mkv_h265, mkv_h264, mkv_vp9, gif.

warning.title: Warning
warning.description: Set when the request was served with an adjusted parameter, e.g. a transparent background falling back to black on a codec that cannot carry alpha.

video.description: Video with removed background and audio.
video.title: Video

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
